title: FIX-732: Feature Flag for Host Agent
description: This tour walks through the changes introduced in FIX-732, which investigates and implements a feature flag mechanism for the Host Agent in helix-cli. The ticket requested adding a feature flag to allow toggling between the old and new agent implementations, leveraging an existing environment variable if one was already present. The change set recorded here captures the ticket metadata and run context that guided the AI agent's investigation.
